intro: Mistress Natalia Mar'alith is a night elf priestess and Cenarion Circle researcher who went missing deep within the silithid nests of Hive'Regal. She ventured into the wastes of Silithus alongside her husband, Commander Mar'alith, before departing on an expedition into the hives.

p: When the Cenarion Circle established their outpost at Cenarion Hold to monitor the awakening sands, Natalia accompanied her husband, Commander Mar'alith, into the wastes. Eager to unravel the mystery behind the resurgence of the silithid and the ancient Qiraji ruins, she joined an exploratory party led by the famed explorer Brann Bronzebeard, accompanied by the dwarven researchers Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge.
